description: Use this when the user wants to see their recent letters, optionally filtered by status. Returns status, recipient, price and tracking number per letter. Changes nothing. Needs the user's account.

limit.description: How many letters to return, newest first: a whole number from 1 to 50. Default 10.

status.description: Only letters with this status, e.g. draft or posted. Omit for letters in any status.

name: list_letters
title: List letters
